label: firsttimedojo
title_zh: Ayane Amamiya 坚定不移的勇气

lines.en: label firsttimedojo:
scene ayanefirstdojo1
I decide to use this brand new lease on life to become a karate champion and check out the dojo.
lines.zh: 我决定利用这全新的一条命，去成为空手道冠军，顺便来看看道场。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: Well, about the karate champion part at least.
lines.zh: 至少「成为空手道冠军」这部分是开玩笑。

lines.en: I just figure that there's a relatively high likelihood of me bumping into someone from class here because...
lines.zh: 我只是觉得在这儿撞上班里某个人的概率相对较高，因为……

lines.en: Wait, why {i}do{/i} I feel like that?
lines.zh: 等等，我为什么{i}会{/i}有这种感觉？

lines.en: I get lost in quiet contemplation for a moment and don't manage to shrug it off until I can hear the excited pounding of footsteps on the floor mat inching closer to me at a frighteningly rapid pace.
lines.zh: 我陷入了一小段安静的沉思，直到听见地板垫上传来兴奋的脚步声，正以吓人的速度朝我逼近，我才回过神来。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo2
: Sensei? What are {i}you{/i} doing here? I've never seen you come by the dojo before.
lines.zh: : Sensei？你{i}来{/i}这儿干什么？我从没见你来过道场。

lines.en: : Better question: what are {i}you{/i} doing here? You just provided weight to an inner monologue I didn't fully understand and now I have to wrap my head around two things at once.
lines.zh: : 更好的问题是：你{i}来{/i}这儿干什么？你刚刚给我一段我自己都没完全搞懂的内心独白提供了佐证，现在我得同时琢磨两件事了。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo3
: Me? I'm training.
lines.zh: : 我？我在训练啊。

lines.en: : Training for what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 训练什么，具体说说？

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo4
: {i}Battle.{/i}
: Well, good luck. I can't imagine there's a lot of that around here.
lines.zh: : 好吧，祝你好运。我可想不出这附近有什么仗可打。

lines.en: : The first rule of karate is to be ready for anything, especially {i}war.{/i}
lines.zh: : 空手道的第一条准则，就是随时做好万全准备，尤其是为了{i}战争{/i}。

lines.en: : I thought the first rule of karate was to only use it as self-defense?
lines.zh: : 我还以为空手道的第一条准则是只能用于自卫？

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo5
: Hmph. Of course that’s what someone without any experience or training would think.
lines.zh: : 哼。没经验、没受过训练的人当然会这么想。

lines.en: : But me? I’ve been here for centuries...honing the Amamiya family secret techniques...and waiting for the perfect moment to showcase my unwavering bravery and reclaim these lands.
lines.zh: : 但我？我已经在这儿待了好几个世纪……磨炼 Amamiya 家秘传的招式……等待一个完美的时机，来展示我坚定不移的勇气，收复这片土地。

lines.en: : Where was that {i}unwavering bravery{/i} when you ran away from my penis the other day?
lines.zh: : 你那天从我阴茎跟前跑掉的时候，那份{i}坚定不移的勇气{/i}去哪儿了？

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo6
: That was no normal penis! And I know a normal penis when I see one! I have done plenty of research!
lines.zh: : 那才不是普通的阴茎！普通的阴茎我一眼就认得出来！我可是做过大量研究的！

lines.en: : Amamiya! What the fuck do you think you're yelling about over there?! And who's that guy with you?!
lines.zh: : Amamiya！你他妈在那边瞎嚷嚷什么？！跟你一块儿那男的是谁？！

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo7
: Sorry, Miss Osaka! He's my...dad!
lines.zh: : 对不起，Osaka 老师！他是我……爸爸！

lines.en: : Your-
lines.zh: : 你的——

lines.en: : You know what? Fuck it. I don't want to deal with this right now. Tell him to either pay up or get out.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？算了，去他妈的。我现在懒得管这些。告诉他，要么交钱，要么滚。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo8
: You need to pay up or get out, Sensei. I'm already on thin ice from bringing my chicken here all the time and can't afford another demerit.
lines.zh: : 你得交钱，不然就得走，Sensei。我因为老把我的鸡带过来，早就如履薄冰了，再也吃不起一次记过。

lines.en: : I have so many questions and feel like none of them are going to be answered.
lines.zh: : 我有一大堆问题，而且感觉一个都不会得到回答。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo3
: If you want to stick around, I wouldn't mind paying for you.
lines.zh: : 如果你想留下来，我不介意替你付钱。

lines.en: : There's a 50%% discount on your first lesson here and, if you like it, it means we can start spending every single waking moment of every single day together.
lines.zh: : 这里的第一节课打五折，而且如果你喜欢，就意味着我们可以开始一起度过每一天的每一刻清醒时光。

lines.en: : Doesn't that sound amazing?
lines.zh: : 听起来是不是很棒？

lines.en: : No. It sounds loud.
lines.zh: : 不。听起来很吵。

lines.en: : Loud can be good. That's another thing I've learned from research.
lines.zh: : 吵也可以是好事。这也是我从研究里学到的。

lines.en: : Ayane, how exactly do you spend all of your free time?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你平时到底是怎么打发空闲时间的？

lines.en: : Thinking about you! Which is where all of the research comes into play. I need to be ready for when {i}you're{/i} ready to love me.
lines.zh: : 想你啊！研究就是这么来的。我得做好准备，等{i}你{/i}准备好来爱我。

lines.en: : Again, you ran away from a solid opportunity to put that to the test and-
lines.zh: : 再说一次，你那天明明有个绝好的机会可以实践一下，结果跑了，而且——

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo6
: Well, forgive me for not expecting the gateway to my dreams to open up in the middle of a sleepover!
lines.zh: : 那你就原谅我吧，谁会想到通往我梦想的门会在留宿派对中途打开啊！

lines.en: : This isn't one of those sex games that Ami and I {i}accidentally{/i} downloaded while you weren't home, Sensei! Things like that don't happen in real life!
lines.zh: : 这可不是我和 Ami 趁你不在家时{i}「不小心」{/i}下载下来的那种色情游戏，Sensei！这种事在现实里不会发生！

lines.en: : I'm a real girl with real feelings and-
lines.zh: : 我是有真实感情的真女孩，而且——

lines.en: : Amamiya!
lines.zh: : Amamiya！

lines.en: : And a real dad who I am trying to convince to start karate right now!
lines.zh: : 还有一个真爸爸，我正试着说服他现在就开始学空手道！

lines.en: : I know you're just covering up, but being called that twice in such quick succession is making me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 我知道你只是在打掩护，但这么短的时间里被叫了两次，让我感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo9
: Well...then tell me what you're doing here. Because you still haven't answered that and it feels extremely random if it's not to see me.
lines.zh: : 那……那你告诉我你来这儿干什么。因为你到现在还没回答，如果不是为了见我，那就太莫名其妙了。

lines.en: : And I haven't even been doing this for long, so I doubt anyone else told you.
lines.zh: : 再说我也没练多久，所以我不信有别人告诉过你。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be like, spending time with Ami or something?
lines.zh: : 你不是该去陪 Ami 之类的吗？

lines.en: : Ami is old enough to do things on her own, just like I’m old enough to visit a random dojo in the middle of the afternoon.
lines.zh: : Ami 已经大到可以自己做自己的事了，就像我也大到可以在大下午随便逛一间道场。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo3
: So it {i}is{/i} just a completely random visit without any purpose or goal.
lines.zh: : 所以这{i}真的{/i}只是一次毫无目的和目标的随机拜访。

lines.en: : Humans are strange creatures, Ayane. We often do things we can't explain or understand.
lines.zh: : 人类是很奇怪的生物，Ayane。我们常做一些自己无法解释、无法理解的事。

lines.en: : Like, you're a teenager in a city nearly devoid of male life and you're spending your afternoon practicing self defense when I imagine all of your friends are off having fun.
lines.zh: : 比如说，你是个几乎没有男性存在的城市里的少女，却把下午花在练自卫术上，而我猜你所有的朋友都去玩了。

lines.en: : What's your explanation for that?
lines.zh: : 对此你作何解释？

lines.en: : And don't give me that whole {i}it's to reclaim my land{/i} thing again. Why are you {i}really{/i} here?
lines.zh: : 而且别再跟我来那套{i}为了收复我的土地{/i}。你{i}到底{/i}为什么在这儿？

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo10
: Humans are strange creatures, Sensei. We often do things we can't explain or understand.
lines.zh: : 人类是很奇怪的生物，Sensei。我们常做一些自己无法解释、无法理解的事。

lines.en: : See? I'm right. You're no different than me.
lines.zh: : 看吧？我说的没错。你和我没什么两样。

lines.en: : We're just two people who somehow landed in a place we don't belong and are now left to either abandon it or adapt.
lines.zh: : 我们只是两个不知怎么落到了不属于自己的地方的人，现在只剩两条路：要么放弃，要么适应。

lines.en: : I vote for adaptation.
lines.zh: : 我投适应一票。

lines.en: : I think we might be members of different parties, then.
lines.zh: : 那我猜我们可能不是同一个党派的了。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo11
: No, no! Hear me out! Karate is crazy fun and {i}great{/i} for your body and mind!
lines.zh: : 不不不！听我说！空手道超级好玩，而且对身心都{i}特别{/i}有益！

lines.en: : Just look what it's done for my muscles! Feel!
lines.zh: : 看看它把我的肌肉练成什么样了！摸摸看！

lines.en: Ayane forcefully grabs my wrist and places my hand on one of her biceps.
lines.zh: Ayane 一把抓住我的手腕，把我的手按在她的二头肌上。

lines.en: Her arms are so small that I’m able to wrap my entire hand around them, but I {i}do{/i} feel a bit of definition there.
lines.zh: 她的手臂细到我能整只手握过来，但我{i}确实{/i}摸到了一点线条。

lines.en: : See? Aren't you impressed?
lines.zh: : 看吧？是不是很厉害？

lines.en: : I feel like it was just yesterday you were poking my arms and calling them squishy. Now, I could probably beat you to death blindfolded!
lines.zh: : 感觉就像昨天你还在戳我的胳膊，说它们软趴趴的。现在，我说不定蒙着眼都能把你打死！

lines.en: : That's an absurd amount of progress for still being relatively new to this.
lines.zh: : 对一个入门没多久的人来说，这进步幅度也太离谱了。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo3
: I'm pretty great at stuff when I actually apply myself, you know. And, up until you showed up, I was trying really hard.
lines.zh: : 我认真起来的时候可是很厉害的，你知道的。而且在你出现之前，我一直都很努力。

lines.en: : Are you saying that I'm the main obstacle preventing you from achieving your goals now?
lines.zh: : 你是说，现在是我成了阻碍你实现目标的最大障碍？

lines.en: : No, I'm saying that there are certain goals that take priority. And one of them decided to show up out of nowhere and surprise me.
lines.zh: : 不，我是说有些目标优先级更高。而其中一个目标突然从天而降，给了我一个惊喜。

lines.en: Unsure of how to respond to that, I shift my gaze across the room to find a good number of girls from all ages doing various drills or...techniques or...whatever you call karate practice.
lines.zh: 不知该怎么回应，我把目光移向房间另一侧，看到不少年纪各异的女生在做各种练习，或者……招式，或者……管它叫什么，反正就是空手道的训练。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo12
The instructor, who looks around my age (Give or take a few years), swiftly moves from group to group, skeptically locking eyes with me every once in a while as if to say {i}get out.{/i}
lines.zh: 那位看起来和我年纪相仿的教练（上下差不了几岁）在各组之间快速穿梭，时不时怀疑地和我锁定视线，仿佛在说{i}滚出去{/i}。

lines.en: Which, to be fair, I probably should. I'm clearly not the...demographic this place is shooting for.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我大概确实该走。我显然不是这地方瞄准的……客群。

lines.en: But if this is where Ayane is going to be spending most of her time...
lines.zh: 但如果 Ayane 打算把大部分时间都花在这儿……

lines.en: Maybe coming around a little more often wouldn't be all that bad?
lines.zh: 也许多来几次也不算太糟？

lines.en: : You know...I really wasn't kidding when I suggested that you should enroll here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我刚才建议你报名这儿，真的不是开玩笑，Sensei。

lines.en: : Wouldn't it be weird, though? I'm the only male and probably the oldest person here.
lines.zh: : 可是不会很怪吗？我是这里唯一的男性，而且大概是年纪最大的。

lines.en: : I don’t think it would be {i}that{/i} weird. We’d just have to act normal and not be all over each other.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不会{i}那么{/i}怪。我们只要表现正常，别黏在一起就行。

lines.en: : That sounds hard when a great deal of your personality seems to revolve around verbally suffocating me.
lines.zh: : 这听起来有点难，毕竟你性格里很大一部分似乎都围绕着用话痨把我闷死。

lines.en: : I can hold back if I have to.
lines.zh: : 如果有必要，我会忍住的。

lines.en: : If that's what it takes to get you here, I'll do it.
lines.zh: : 如果这是让你来这儿的代价，我愿意。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo10
: I want more of you, Sensei. A lot more. And I don't just mean that in a weird way.
lines.zh: : 我想要更多你，Sensei。多得多。而且我说的还不只是那种奇怪的意思。

lines.en: : I do mean it in a {i}kind of{/i} weird way. But not entirely weird. Maybe like...fifty-fifty?
lines.zh: : 我确实也有一点{i}奇怪{/i}的意思。但也不全是奇怪。大概……五五开？

lines.en: : And you think one of those fifties would be able to keep the other in check if I decide to start...doing karate or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你觉得要是我决定开始……练空手道什么的，其中那一半能管住另一半吗？

lines.en: : Isn't that the whole idea of halves? To balance each other out?
lines.zh: : 两半的意义不就在于互相平衡吗？

lines.en: : Join the class, Sensei. I really don't mind paying for you. I put it all on my credit card anyway.
lines.zh: : 来报名吧，Sensei。我真的不介意替你付钱。反正都是刷我的信用卡。

lines.en: : I just...can't foresee myself actually enjoying karate, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我只是……没法想象自己真的会喜欢上空手道，Ayane。

lines.en: : Then enjoy my company- the same way I've been enjoying yours for years.
lines.zh: : 那就享受我的陪伴好了——就像我这些年一直享受你的陪伴那样。

lines.en: : I'm not young and immature anymore.
lines.zh: : 我已经不是那个又小又不成熟的我了。

lines.en: : Yes you are.
lines.zh: : 你就是。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo13
: Okay. Yes, I am...But I am {i}less{/i} young and {i}less{/i} immature.
lines.zh: : 好吧。是的，我是……但我{i}没那么{/i}小，也{i}没那么{/i}不成熟了。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo3
: And I'm ready to take things to the next level in the least creepy way I could possibly say that which, I admit, still probably sounds kind of creepy.
lines.zh: : 而且我已经准备好，用我能想出的最不恶心的方式，把我们的关系推进到下一阶段——虽然我承认，这话听起来大概还是有点恶心。

lines.en: : It's fine. I'm kind of creepy for not walking away by now anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我到现在还没走开，本身就已经够恶心了。
: 所以……

lines.en: : Does this mean we can be creeps together?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着我们可以一起当变态了？

lines.en: I take another look around the dojo and try to figure out if this is really where I want to be spending a good chunk of my time.
lines.zh: 我又环顾了一圈道场，试图搞清楚这里到底是不是我真想花大把时间待的地方。

lines.en: And...I don't think it is.
lines.zh: 然后……我觉得不是。

lines.en: But when my eyes realign and I'm stuck staring directly ahead-
lines.zh: 但当我的视线重新对上，直直地定在前方——

lines.en: I make a decision.
lines.zh: 我做出了决定。

lines.en: For sometimes, it's a matter less of {i}where{/i} you are and more {i}who{/i} you're with.
lines.zh: 因为有时候，重要的不是你身在{i}何处{/i}，而是你与{i}谁{/i}在一起。

lines.en: And I struggle to say it in a way that wouldn't land me on a list somewhere-
lines.zh: 我很难用一种不会让我被列进某个名单的说法来表述——

lines.en: But I think I want more of Ayane just as badly as she wants more of me.
lines.zh: 但我想，我渴望得到更多 Ayane 的程度，大概和她渴望得到更多我的程度一样强烈。

lines.en: : I think it does.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是的。

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo14
: Heck yeah, let's go!
lines.zh: : 太好了，我们走！

lines.en: : I'll sign the papers right now! You just wait right here, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我现在就去签文件！你就在这儿等着，Sensei！

lines.en: : Wouldn't I need to sign them if-
lines.zh: : 那我不需要自己签吗，如果——

lines.en: : Nope! I've already memorized your signature and used it on several official documents, so you can just leave this part to me!
lines.zh: : 不用！我已经把你的签名背下来了，还在好几份正式文件上用过，这部分就交给我吧！

lines.en: : What? What documents did-
lines.zh: : 什么？什么文件你——

lines.en: scene ayanefirstdojo1
: Ayane, come on. You can't just walk away without telling me that.
lines.zh: : Ayane，别这样。你不能就这么走掉不告诉我。

lines.en: scene black
$ firsttimedojo = True
$ ayane_love += 1
{i}Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Ayane 的好感度提升到了 [ayane_love]!{/i}

lines.en: scene black
jump saturdaynight
